digest.component_or_area: git hook installation and pre-commit integration
propositions: The documented curl command to install commit-msg hook uses git rev-parse --git-path which resolves to shared hooks directory on all worktrees, causing the command run from a linked worktree to overwrite the pre-commit wrapper in the main checkout.

Running the documented hook install command silently destroys the pre-commit wrapper, leaving Change-Id stamping broken across all worktrees on the host, with failure only surfacing later during git push gerrit.

The unsafe curl installation violates the pre-commit migration mode arrangement documented in .pre-commit-config.yaml, which requires preserving both the pre-commit wrapper and Gerrit stamper in a chain rather than replacing one with the other.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md instructs users to run an unsafe bare curl over git rev-parse output, providing no warnings or guard rails against the worktree-unsafe operation.

A worktree-safe and idempotent hook installation method that installs to commit-msg.legacy when a pre-commit wrapper exists, refuses unsafe overwrites with loud errors, and validates hook payload before installing must be the single documented path.
